narratives.Description: [framework-gap] directive upgrade to 0.132.0 omits .agents/hooks.json, .agents/deft-hook-*.mjs, and Claude SessionEnd hook until verify:hooks-installed --repair runs
narratives.Overview:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `directive install` and `directive upgrade` deposit the agy host hooks when `plan.policy.hostHooks.agy` is on and the committed verdict admits them: the `zzzz-directive` entry in `.agents/hooks.json` and `.agents/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs`, so `directive doctor --full` reports `agent-hooks-registration` green right after the command.
- [ ] `.deft/GENERATION.json` ownership records the `zzzz-directive` entry of `.agents/hooks.json` (entry-owned, not the whole file) and the agy outer `.agents/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs` (whole-file owned).
- [ ] `directive uninstall` removes only the `zzzz-directive` entry from `.agents/hooks.json`, keeps foreign hook entries byte for byte, deletes the file only when it would be empty, and removes the agy outer.
- [ ] The doctor host-config list, the removal steps, and the launcher host lists (`HOST_HOOK_RELS`, `HOST_HOOK_OUTER_DIRS`, the repair opt-out disclosure) include agy.
- [ ] Install and upgrade register the Claude `SessionEnd` hook in `.claude/settings.json`.
- [ ] Hygiene claims only Directive's own entries under `.agents/` (the `zzzz-directive` hook entry and Directive-managed skills); a foreign `.agents/hooks.json` entry or foreign skill is never reported or stripped as Directive's.
- [ ] The host-tool-coverage audit covers agy, treating the single `*` matcher as every tool.
- [ ] The outer install-admit test includes an agy `run_command` / `toolCall.args.CommandLine` payload.

issueCommentThread.body:
Follow-up root-cause pointers from inspecting the published `0.132.0` packages (internal benchmark evidence (private)):

The gap is broader than `directive upgrade` — the OVPR bookend installer, ownership recorder, uninstaller, and launcher still hardcode only the four pre-`agy` hosts (`.claude`, `.cursor`, `.codex`, `.grok`), while `plan.policy.hostHooks.agy` now defaults to `true` and `agy-activation` passes:

- `@deftai/directive-runtime`:
  - `dist/setup-wiring.js` — only wires `.claude/settings.json`, `.cursor/hooks.json`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.grok/hooks/deft.json` (omits `.agents/hooks.json`, `.agents/deft-hook-*.mjs`, and Claude `SessionEnd`).
  - `dist/setup.js` — `GENERATION.json` ownership list only records the 4 older host hook configs/outers.
  - `dist/doctor-diagnose.js` — host config list only checks the 4 older hosts.
  - `dist/removal-steps/steps.js` and `dist/uninstall.js` — `HOST_HOOK_RELS` / `HOST_HOOK_OUTER_DIRS` only enumerate the 4 older host dirs, so `directive uninstall` would not remove `.agents/hooks.json` or `.agents/deft-hook-*.mjs` even after manual repair.
- `@deftai/directive` (launcher):
  - `dist/bin.js` — `HOST_HOOK_RELS`, `HOST_HOOK_OUTER_DIRS`, and `hostHookRepairOptOutDisclosureBullet` only enumerate the 4 older hosts.

**Consumer impact:** Any consumer running `directive install` or `directive upgrade` on `0.132.0` exits 0 without `.agents/hooks.json`, then immediately hits `agent-hooks-registration INCOMPLETE` in `directive doctor` / `deft verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` (even on repos not using Antigravity), and manual `verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent --repair` leaves `.agents/hooks.json` and `.agents/deft-hook-*.mjs` untracked by `.deft/GENERATION.json` and `directive uninstall`.

Rewriting the body to criteria-only for ingest (Scott: "yes take through merge, no arc"; #7434 folded in). Operator decision recorded here: `.agents/hooks.json` is a shared file and is **entry-owned** -- Directive owns only its `zzzz-directive` entry; uninstall strips that entry with the #7347 strip (foreign hooks kept byte for byte) and deletes the file only when it would be empty; `GENERATION.json` records the entry, not the file. The agy outer `.agents/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs` stays whole-file owned. Prior body quoted below for the audit trail.

<details><summary>Prior body</summary>

## Summary

directive upgrade to 0.132.0 omits .agents/hooks.json, .agents/deft-hook-*.mjs, and Claude SessionEnd hook until verify:hooks-installed --repair runs

## Context

Upgrading a consumer OVPR project from 0.131.5 to 0.132.0 (maintainer dist-tag) via directive upgrade --target-version 0.132.0 --yes on Windows (internal benchmark evidence (private)).

## Expected behavior

directive upgrade --target-version 0.132.0 --yes deposits all enabled host hooks (including .agents/hooks.json, .agents/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs, and .claude/settings.json SessionEnd) so directive doctor --full reports agent-hooks-registration green immediately after upgrade.

## Actual behavior / gap

directive upgrade exited 0 and updated package.json, package-lock.json, .deft/GENERATION.json, and existing Claude/Codex/Cursor/Grok hook files, but did not create .agents/hooks.json or .agents/deft-hook-aee61ba9.mjs and did not add SessionEnd to .claude/settings.json. Running directive doctor --full immediately afterward warned agent-hooks-registration INCOMPLETE: agy missing at .agents/hooks.json. Running deft verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent --repair then deposited .agents/hooks.json, .agents/deft-hook-aee61ba9.mjs, and .claude/settings.json SessionEnd and cleared the warning.

## Session notes

Observed on @deftai/directive 0.132.0 + @deftai/directive-runtime 0.132.0 (plan.policy.hostHooks defaults agy: true; agy-activation: pass). Source: internal benchmark evidence (private).

---
_Filed via `deft feedback:file` from a directive consumer project (Refs #1709 value-feedback gap escalation)._



</details>
